0.original: Eilis bears grim work for an accomplished adventurer.

1.original: Eilis informs you that the Sahagin are looking to launch an attack on Tidegate. Slay four of the creatures that prowl near by way of discouragement.

2.original: Inform Eilis that you have delayed the advance of the Sahagin front line.

3.original: Eilis will rest easier knowing you have kept her nightmare at bay.

48.original: Beyond Tidegate lies the Sahagin Landbase, whence the fishbacks mean to launch an attack.

49.original: Though we cannot forestall their advance, we might give them pause with a sudden strike. I'll need you to make four Sahagin serve as a cautionary tale for the rest.

52.original: A job well done! Let us see how the fishbacks fancy that!

53.original: Each day, the hordes of slimy Sahagin soldiers threaten to take our beloved gates. I pray the day never comes, but prayer alone will not suffice. Thanks to you, today will not be that day.
